name: digital-facebook-publishing
description: Digital products Facebook Publishing (same setup as affiliate FB publishing, kept separate): Page/token verification -> upload Reel -> save FB publication record separately from IG. Description is the product's own caption (no affiliate disclosure).

nodes.name: webhook-entry
nodes.notes: Entry: POST {product, downloadUrl} with x-n8n-secret header.

nodes.name: verify-page
nodes.notes: Verifies the FB Page + page token before any upload (§14). Fails safe.

nodes.name: if-uploaded
nodes.notes: Finish returned success=true → save FB record. Else park.

nodes.name: save-fb-id
nodes.notes: Saves FB publication record SEPARATELY from IG (§14, §19).

nodes.name: fb-reel-start
nodes.notes: FB Reel 1/3: start upload session on /video_reels (Graph API v26.0). Returns video_id + upload_url.

nodes.name: fb-reel-upload
nodes.notes: FB Reel 2/3: send the rendered MP4 by URL to the rupload host. Auth scheme here is 'OAuth', NOT Bearer.

nodes.name: fb-reel-finish
nodes.notes: FB Reel 3/3: publish with video_state=PUBLISHED. Response is {success:true} (no id field).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ upload_phase: 'finish', video_id: $('fb-reel-start').first().json.video_id, video_state: 'PUBLISHED', description: (($('webhook-entry').first().json.body.product.script.caption ?? '')), access_token: $('resolve-account').first().json.data.fbPageToken }) }}

parameters.content:
## FB Reel setup (§14) — verified 2026-10-21 against 2026 Graph API guides
1. **Permissions** on your Meta app: `pages_manage_posts` (needs `pages_read_engagement` + `pages_show_list`).
2. **Own Page only → Development mode is enough.** You are app admin/tester AND Page admin, so no app review and no business verification needed (same logic as IG own-account dev mode). App review + verification only apply when publishing for other people's Pages.
3. **Token:** short user token (1h) → exchange for long-lived user token (60 days) → `GET /me/accounts` → copy the Page token into `FB_PAGE_TOKEN`. The Page token itself does not expire; re-fetch it whenever you refresh the 60-day user token. Error code 190 = token expired → re-run this flow.
4. **Reels edge:** `/video_reels` 3-step flow (start → rupload bytes/file_url with header `Authorization: OAuth`, NOT Bearer → finish `video_state=PUBLISHED`). The old `/videos` edge posts a regular feed video, NOT a Reel.
5. **Reel specs:** 9:16 MP4, ≥540×960, H.264+AAC; duration 3s–90s per one guide, up to 20 min per another — our 15s / 30–60s renders fit either way.
Caveat: secondary 2026 guides, not Meta's own docs — live-verify at Phase 7.

nodes.name: record-publish
nodes.notes: Record the publish in the backend so the repost monitor can track performance. Best-effort: never fails the publish.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ platform: 'facebook_reels', platformMediaId: $('save-fb-id').first().json.product.publications.facebook.mediaId, videoUrl: $('webhook-entry').first().json.body.downloadUrl, caption: $('webhook-entry').first().json.body.product.script.caption, publishedAt: new Date().toISOString(), jobId: $('webhook-entry').first().json.body.jobId }) }}
